<function name="DOFModeHack" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
A hacky method used to fix some bugs regarding DoF. What this basically does it force all `C_BaseAnimating` entities to have the translucent <page text="rendergroup">Enums/RENDERGROUP</page>, even if they use opaque or two-pass models.

This is specifically to do with <page>GM:NeedsDepthPass</page>

<internal></internal>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="enable" type="boolean">Enables or disables depth-of-field mode</arg>
	</args>
</function>
